items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Zutty left and we had another drummer by the name of Doc Young -- no, Doc West, Harold West... So he played with us for quite a while

ctx.x: Yeah, just all night long we just jammed. It was just a most rewarding experience, and good, you know.

Zutty left and we had another drummer by the name of Doc Young -- no, Doc West, Harold West, who was a very fine drummer. You've heard of West. Yeah. So he played with us for quite a while, and then I -- this is the first time I went to New York was with Roy Eldridge. We played the Savoy. At this time Paul Whiteman had acclaimed claimed Roy the world's greatest trumpet player.
